🪁 Lightkite Helm Charts

Modern Kubernetes Dashboard

Quick Start

1. Install from OCI registry

helm install lightkite oci://ghcr.io/<owner>/charts/lightkite --version <version> -n lightkite-system --create-namespace -f values.yaml

2. Or add repository

helm repo add lightkite <repository-url>
helm repo update

3. Install Chart

helm install lightkite lightkite/lightkite --version <version> -n lightkite-system --create-namespace -f values.yaml

Available Versions

helm search repo lightkite
or view the Repository Index.
